privacy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. This privacy policy explains how we handle your data.
privacy.placeholder: Detailed privacy policy will be added...
privacy.authority_name: State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information for North Rhine-Westphalia
privacy.basis_contract: Fulfillment of the contract and pre-contractual inquiries (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b) GDPR)
privacy.basis_interest: Legitimate interests (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f) GDPR)
privacy.basis_legal: Legal obligation (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. c) GDPR)
privacy.changes: Changes and updates to the data protection declaration
privacy.changes_desc:
We ask you to regularly inform yourself about the content of this data protection declaration. 
We will adapt the data protection declaration as soon as changes to the data processing we carry out make this necessary. 
We will inform you as soon as the changes require your cooperation (e.g. consent) or other individual notification.
privacy.contact_form: Contact us via website contact form
privacy.contact_form_data:
If you send us inquiries using the contact form, your inquiries, including the contact details you provided there, will be stored by us for the purpose of processing and answering the inquiry and in the event of follow-up questions and will be further processed accordingly. 
This also applies to your IP address and the date and time you sent your message to us. 
We do not pass on this data to third parties unless this is necessary in the context of processing and answering your contact request or you have given us your corresponding consent (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. a) GDPR).
privacy.contact_form_legal_basis: Fulfillment of the contract and pre-contractual inquiries (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. b) GDPR) as well as safeguarding our legitimate interests (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. f) GDPR)
privacy.contact_form_retention: Storage period: The relevant data is based on Section 5 of this data protection declaration.
privacy.contract_data_retention:
Contract data: Until the end of the contractual relationship. 
Server log files: 30 days. 
IP addresses: 7 days. 
Newsletter addresses: 3 years.
privacy.controller_address: Tech Boulevard 123, 60386 Frankfurt am Main, Germany
privacy.controller_representatives:
Dr. 
Alexander Schmidt, Dr. 
Sarah Müller
privacy.cookies: Use of cookies and similar tracking technologies
privacy.cookies_desc:
We sometimes use so-called cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website, such as tracking pixels or fingerprinting technologies. 
The tracking serves to make our offers more user-friendly, effective and secure and to personalize content and advertising.
privacy.cookies_functional:
Functional tracking: In these cases, the legal basis for accessing your device, collecting the information and further processing any personal data is Section 25 Paragraph 2 No. 2 TDDDG and Article 6 Paragraph 1 Letter f) or Letter b) GDPR. 
The absolutely necessary tracking helps us to make a website technically usable and secure.
privacy.cookies_marketing:
Tracking for marketing, personalization or analytics purposes: Your voluntary consent is required for all other purposes mentioned. 
The legal basis is then Section 25 Paragraph 1 TDDDG and Article 6 Paragraph 1 Letter a) GDPR. 
You can grant collective consent for all purposes by selecting "Accept all".
privacy.cookies_optout:
Option to object (opt-out): You can revoke the consent you have given at any time. 
To do this, click on “Cookie Settings” at the bottom of the website and either select “Reject all” or deactivate individual categories.
privacy.cookies_storage: Storage period: Once consent has been given, these cookies can be stored for a period of up to 24 months.
privacy.data_categories_desc: Interested parties, communication partners, business and contractual partners
privacy.data_provision: Obligation to provide data: In principle, you are not obliged to provide us with your personal data.
privacy.data_retention: Duration of data processing and deletion
privacy.data_retention_desc: We initially process your personal data for the period necessary for the respective processing purpose.
privacy.data_transfers: Transfer of personal data to third countries
privacy.data_transfers_dpf:
EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF): Some of our service providers are certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (as of July 2023). 
The list of certified companies and additional information about the DPF can be found on the US Department of Commerce website.
privacy.data_transfers_scc:
To the extent necessary for our purposes, we transmit your data to recipients in third countries (outside the European Union). 
We only transfer data to recipients in third countries in compliance with the provisions in Chapter V of the GDPR, i.e. if it is established that the EU Commission has established an adequate level of data protection within the meaning of Article 45 Paragraph 1 GDPR or that appropriate guarantees within the meaning of Article 46 Paragraph 2 and Paragraph 3 GDPR have been implemented or an exception pursuant to Article 49 Paragraph 1 GDPR exists.
privacy.data_types_desc: Inventory data, contact data, content data, contract data, usage data, meta, communication and procedural data
privacy.kai_disclaimer:
Advice on the calidad of the IA: The contents are generated by the applications of the IA and contain errors and inexactitudes. 
No information is verified or certified, but the contents are created automatically and are not updated. 
Nexary no asume responsabilidad por los daños que podrían derivarse del uso de dichos contenidos.
privacy.legal_bases: Relevant legal bases according to the GDPR
privacy.newsletter_consent: Consent: The newsletter will only be sent with your express consent (Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. a) GDPR).
privacy.newsletter_content: Content: Information about us, our services, promotions and offers.
privacy.newsletter_double_opt:
We use the so-called double opt-in procedure: After you register, you will receive an email asking you to confirm your newsletter subscription. 
Without this confirmation, your registration will not be completed.
privacy.newsletter_optout:
Unsubscribe: You can unsubscribe from the newsletter at any time - regardless of whether you receive it based on consent or legitimate interests. 
To do this, use the unsubscribe link at the end of each newsletter.
privacy.newsletter_storage: Storage period: The email address is stored for up to 3 years before we delete it in order to be able to prove that consent was previously given.
privacy.platform: Use of our platform and AI applications
privacy.platform_avp: Order processing agreement (AVV): We have concluded a corresponding order processing agreement (AVV) with the customer in accordance with Art. 28 Para. 3 GDPR.
privacy.platform_desc: If you use third-party AI applications via our platform as an authorized user, this customer is the person responsible within the meaning of Art. 4 No. 7 GDPR for the processing of your personal data as part of the use.
privacy.platform_processing: Processed data: name, email address of the user, company data for business customers, chats and inputs, AI models used, tokens consumed, usage statistics.
privacy.platform_purpose: Purposes: Provision of contractual services and fulfillment of our contractual obligations.
privacy.purposes_desc: Provision of contractual services and customer service, contact inquiries and communication, security measures, reach measurement, provision of the online offering and user-friendliness
privacy.register_court: Registration court: Frankfurt am Main District Court, HRB 123456
privacy.retention_website:
Storage period and deletion: Your IP address will be stored for a maximum of 7 days for IT security purposes. 
Server log files are stored for a maximum of 30 days and then deleted.
privacy.right_complaint: Right to complain to a supervisory authority: Without prejudice to any other administrative or judicial remedy, you have the right to complain to a supervisory authority, in particular in the Member State of your habitual residence, your place of work or the place of the alleged infringement, if you believe that the processing of personal data concerning you violates the GDPR.
privacy.right_consent: Right to revoke consent: You have the right to revoke your consent at any time.
privacy.right_correct: Right to rectification: In accordance with legal requirements, you have the right to request that incorrect data concerning you be completed or that incorrect data concerning you be corrected.
privacy.right_delete: Right to deletion: You have the right to request that the data concerning you be deleted immediately, or alternatively to request that the processing of the data be restricted in accordance with legal requirements.
privacy.right_info: Right to information: You have the right to request confirmation as to whether the data in question is being processed and to receive information about this data as well as further information and copies of the data in accordance with legal requirements.
privacy.right_oppose:
Right to object: Under the conditions set out in Article 21 Paragraph 1 GDPR, you have the right, for reasons arising from your particular situation, to object at any time to the processing of personal data concerning you, which is carried out on the basis of Article 6 Paragraph 1 lit. e or f) GDPR; 
This also applies to profiling based on these provisions.
privacy.right_portability: Right to data portability: You have the right to receive the data concerning you that you have provided to us in a structured, common and machine-readable format in accordance with the legal requirements or to request that it be transmitted to another person responsible.
privacy.website_data: Each time our website is accessed, the following data is automatically collected: browser type and browser version, operating system used, IP address of the requesting device, website from which access is made (origin or referrer URL), date and time of access, sub-pages visited and time spent there
privacy.website_legal_basis:
The processing of access data is technically necessary to provide a functional website and for system security. 
In addition to the above purposes, we use server log files exclusively to tailor and optimize our website on a purely statistical basis and without drawing any conclusions about you personally. 
This data will not be merged with other data sources.
privacy.website_purpose: Technical provision and system security (contract fulfillment and pre-contractual inquiries Art. 6 Para. 1 lit. b) GDPR)

multiModel.description: All leading AI models on one platform – OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Open Source. Smart Select AI automatically chooses the best model.

rag.title: RAG Pipeline
rag.description: Direct access to SharePoint, Confluence and more with automatic synchronization of your enterprise data.

assistants.title: Assistant Library
assistants.description: Configure custom assistants with your own files, documents and extensions for your specific needs.

webSearch.title: Web Search
webSearch.description: Research current information via Google or Perplexity with automatic source citations.

imageGen.title: Image Generation
imageGen.description: Create high-quality digital images from natural language using GPT Image 1 or Gemini.

codeInterpreter.title: Code Interpreter
codeInterpreter.description: Write, understand and debug code – directly in the platform with interactive execution.

deepResearch.title: Deep Research
deepResearch.description: Conduct in-depth analyses, evaluate sources and create well-founded reports.

documentChat.title: Document Chat
documentChat.description: Analyze PDFs, Word documents and presentations and ask questions directly about the content.

analytics.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics.description: Detailed usage analytics, cost overview and model distribution at a glance.
